svg.title: Selection is not a profit
svg.desc: A fictional-price experiment selects trend60 using development only. Its development return is positive, but its separate holdout loses money; the equal-weight baseline also loses. Both complete equity paths include initial capital and all marked sessions. Each region starts a separate 100000-unit account, while cash persists across folds inside that region. The first holdout buy shows reference notional, adverse execution, commission and remaining cash. Train-only ridge label endpoints remain before every exclusive cutoff.
svg.text: Freeze the choice before opening the holdout.
6 expanding development fits; labels end before cutoffs.
First ridge cutoff 252; latest training label 251.
Separate account starts at 100; net of execution.
